s4a_unaccounted_essence.title: Unaccounted Essence
s4a_unaccounted_essence._comment: Narrative N1. Sets contraband_on (read by N2 contraband).

dispatch.text: Dispatch: essence is unaccounted for. The Warden suspects the shortfall is a rumour about you.

effects.title: Unaccounted essence
effects.text: Refined stock has been 'mislaid'. Please mislay it less.

s4b_stash_inventory.title: The Stash Inventory
s4b_stash_inventory._comment: Narrative N1. Let it ride -> clue_buyer (a buyer asked for the calm stuff).

count.text: The stash is big enough to have its own paperwork. The squad awaits instructions.

shakedown.label: Squad shakedown
shakedown.text: The squad finds it in the third mattress. Morale is a separate line item.

ride.label: Let it ride
ride.text: A buyer arrives and asks for 'the calm stuff'. Not for the money. For the calm.
ride.hint: Black market grows. You learn who is buying.

effects.title: A buyer
effects.text: They asked for the calm stuff.

turn_in.label: Turn it in
turn_in.text: The Warden is touched. The skimmers are not.
turn_in.hint: Warden favour. Lifers -15. Petition fee x0.95 for 5 d.
